title: TSMC September Revenue Jumps 54.6% as Growth Continues
text:
Daniel Nenni
Founder
Staff member

TSMC reported September 2026 consolidated revenue of NT$511.86 billion, up 54.6% from a year earlier, despite a slight decline from August. The figures show substantial annual growth at the contract chipmaker, although the monthly report does not identify which customers or technologies contributed to the increase.

September revenue fell 0.6% from August’s NT$514.81 billion. Compared with September 2025 revenue of NT$330.98 billion, however, the company generated approximately NT$180.88 billion more sales. The contrast highlights why a small monthly movement should be assessed alongside the broader annual trend.

For January through September, TSMC recorded revenue of NT$3.90 trillion, an increase of 41.1% over the same period in 2025. That cumulative performance indicates that September’s strong annual comparison forms part of a sustained expansion across the first nine months, rather than an isolated spike.

Why it matters: TSMC’s revenue offers a useful indicator of activity in the semiconductor supply chain. Customers rely on foundries to turn chip designs into manufactured silicon, making sales growth relevant to businesses supplying fabrication equipment, materials, and supporting services. The results suggest a larger revenue base supporting TSMC’s operations.

The scale of growth also matters to discussions about future manufacturing investment. Sustained sales expansion can strengthen the financial foundation for capacity additions and technology development. However, this release contains no capital expenditure update, capacity figures, or process node breakdown, so it cannot establish where additional investment will occur.

For AI industry observers, the numbers provide context, but not proof of AI-specific demand growth. The report does not separate AI processors from smartphone, automotive, or other chips. Nor does it disclose unit shipments, pricing changes, profitability, or customer concentration.
